question: Does smoother route temperature restore non-negligible routing reliance and unseen-experiment robustness for extreme E32/E64 banks?
hypothesis: Temperature 0.1 reduces brittle expert collapse relative to the locked temperature-0.03 extreme screen.
predicted_signature: Randomized-route reliance exceeds 0.01 and the matched tail-safe-minus-zero-auxiliary direction is nonnegative on OOD-validation mean and worst-experiment accuracy without more than two ID points lost.
alternative_explanation: Any score change is generic auxiliary regularization or total-parameter scaling rather than useful conditional routing.
falsifier: Route reliance remains below 0.01 or the matched mean/tail direction is inconsistent at epochs 30 and 60.
pruning_rule: At epoch 10 prune only if dominated on OOD-validation mean, ID retention, worst-experiment accuracy, and routing reliance; otherwise adjudicate at 30 and advance to 60 only for a competitive trajectory or mechanism signature.
multiplicity: Exploratory four-cell addendum opened after near-zero route reliance in locked E2; any winner requires locked fresh-seed confirmation without further tuning.
